items.title: missing-kick-foot
items.claim: In Image #13, Asmongold’s extended kicking leg ends at an open trouser cuff with no visible foot, while HasanAbi stands clear of it.
items.reason: The incomplete silhouette makes the kick’s reach difficult to judge.
items.suggest: Repair the extended front-kick sprite to include the bare foot and a complete ankle-to-toe silhouette.

items.title: fraction-baseline-mismatch
items.claim: In Image #8, the denominator of HasanAbi’s 2½ HUD score drops below both the whole number and fighter name, and the result banner repeats this oversized stacked fraction.
items.reason: Players must decipher a vertically broken score instead of reading it immediately.
items.suggest: Render the half point with a baseline-aligned ½ glyph on the same line as the whole number in both locations.

items.title: block-effect-below-contact
items.claim: In Image #12, the blue block particles cluster around HasanAbi’s belt and legs while Asmongold’s extended kick meets his upper torso.
items.reason: The effect identifies a different contact location from the fighters’ visible pose.
items.suggest: Anchor the initial block burst where the kicking limb meets the defender, then let trailing particles fall from that point.

items.title: tiny-phone-labels
items.claim: In Image #3, the fighter-name and joystick-caption capital letters are approximately 8 CSS px tall at the stated 390px viewport scale.
items.reason: These labels are difficult to read during play on a phone.
items.suggest: Set their font size to at least 18 CSS px, reduce letter spacing, and adjust HUD wrapping to accommodate the larger text.

items.title: small-fighters-at-distance
items.claim: The fighters are approximately 130 CSS px tall in Image #22 versus approximately 200 CSS px in Image #3, despite the matching phone viewport and joystick layout.
items.reason: The smaller presentation makes attack poses and spacing harder to distinguish.
items.suggest: Raise the minimum portrait fighter height to approximately 160 CSS px and tighten camera framing around both fighters.
